benefits.titleZh: 描述忙碌的尋找和辦事過程
benefits.zh: chase around、chase about 和 chase round 可以描述為了尋找或處理事情而四處奔走。
benefits.en: Chase around, chase about and chase round help you describe going to many places while looking for or arranging something.

benefits.titleZh: 描述把人或動物趕離某處
benefits.titleEn: Describe making people or animals leave
benefits.zh: chase away、chase off 和 chase out 可以清楚表示把誰或甚麼動物趕離某個地方。
benefits.en: Chase away, chase off and chase out help you explain clearly who or what was made to leave a place.

benefits.titleZh: 談論經過努力才找到的人或資料
benefits.titleEn: Talk about finding someone or something difficult to locate
benefits.zh: 當某人、地址、電話號碼或其他資料很難找到時，可以使用 chase down。
benefits.en: Chase down is useful when finding a person, address, number or other information requires real effort.

benefits.titleEn: Ask again for an answer or action
benefits.zh: 當你需要再次查問訂單、表格、預訂、回覆或尚未完成的事情時，可以使用 chase up。
benefits.en: Chase up is common when you need to contact someone again about an order, form, booking, reply or unfinished task.
